Method of Attack: Phishing email pretending to be a shared file on SANS SharePoint
User prompted to click 'Open' button leading to a malicious URL
Malicious OAuth Microsoft Office addon installed
Addon creates forwarding rule 'Anti Spam Rule' to forward emails with financial keywords to external attacker-controlled address
Attack Vector: Phishing email with malicious OAuth consent app
Indicators of Compromise: Phishing email with attachment named 'Copy of July Bonus 24JUL2020.xls'
